90-Day Pilot

Growth Pilot Walkthrough

This demo shows how the pilot could work in practice: a prospect lands on a focused page, submits an inquiry, and moves through a simple follow-up process.

  • Focused landing page for consultation requests
  • Lead records, notes, and scheduled follow-ups
  • Pipeline stages for inquiry follow-through
  • Reporting views for conversion and acquisition cost

Dashboard

Campaign Results Overview

The overview shows lead flow, booked consultations, attended meetings, and placed policies during the pilot.

Lead Capture

Consultation Request Page

The landing page shows how a campaign click can become a clear inquiry for Sharon’s team.

  • Two-column desktop layout and stacked mobile layout
  • Consultation form with need and timing fields
  • Submitted inquiries move into the follow-up workflow

Lead Records

Lead Details And Follow-Ups

Sharon’s team can keep contact details, notes, and scheduled follow-ups in one place.

  • Add leads with contact details and source
  • Record notes after each conversation
  • Schedule follow-ups directly from the selected record

Follow-Up Workflow

Inquiry Pipeline

The pipeline gives Sharon’s team a simple way to move leads from new inquiry to outcome.

  • Desktop drag between stages
  • Mobile tap-and-hold drag with stacked stages
  • Card tap selects the lead without a separate select button

Campaign Links

Funnel Links And Email Copy

The funnel builder creates campaign links and email copy Sharon’s team can send quickly.

  • Choose audience, offer, and destination
  • Generate a shareable campaign URL
  • Copy link or open an email draft

Reporting

90-Day Pilot Scorecard

The reporting view helps Sharon review whether the pilot is producing useful conversations at a reasonable cost.

  • Adjust ad spend and agency fee assumptions
  • Review acquisition cost and projected commission
  • Show conversion from inquiry to policy outcome
